individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph showing spatial clusters overlaid on a tissue image, not a quantification plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B consists of H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a quantification plot.
The spatial expression maps are heatmap-style overlays on tissue images; individual data points are not meaningful for heatmaps.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual points is not applicable/would make them unreadable.
This is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from aggregated spatial transcriptomics comparisons, but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot values) are overlaid on the bars.
